heading.title: Of the Produce and Interest of Legacies

article.title: No interest on arrears of annuity within first year after testator’s death.
article.content:
354No interest on arrears of annuity within first year after testator’s death.

Section 354  ·  Part IX · Chapter XI  ·  page 89 of the Act
No interest is payable on the arrears of an annuity within the first year from the death of the testator, although a period earlier than the expiration of that year may have been fixed by will for making the first payment of the annuity.
